items.title: Blizzard Announces Name Reservation Issue for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever
items.snippet: Blizzard has announced a name reservation issue for Oceanic Players who are connecting to Australian-based servers.

items.title: Update: Name Reservations for WoW: Forever Now Live in EU, NA Players Seeing Disconnects
items.snippet: Updated: The delay on Forever name reservations is complete, and players can now reserve their names on EU! NA players, however, are seeing auto-disconnects after queues.
